messages.subject: Request: classy inputs with style
parts:
Request:

  I should be able to add classes and style to the convenience input generators.

  Barriers:

  1) extra classes are actively removed from shiny inputs and outputs.  I guess this is a side effect of registration
  2) the convenience functions provide no way to add classes or style, and while I can write RXML extensions, they don't always work

Suggestion:

  A) add an optional field or fields class= and style= to all input functions which decorate the inputs with classes and styles specified
  B) provide wrapper functions for applying classes and styles.

-Alex
